default/31848.htm.text: Pixy: According to the contract made by our queen and Nerupa, we take care of the forest, the Mother Tree Glade, and the Nymphs. I m not pleased to watch over the immature Elves, but our fairy race always keeps our promises. We punish those who disturb the order of the forest!
